findings.evidence: Integral.lean:142,150 vs 166,173 identical text; Basic.lean:73 `IsCompletelyMonotone` on `Ici 0` vs Basic.lean:273 `IsCompletelyMonotoneOnIoi` on `Ioi 0`.
findings.fix: Reword both to match l.124-125, e.g. "…of a function that is completely monotone on `(0, ∞)` and continuous on `[0, ∞)`…", so each of the four pairs is distinguishable in generated docs.
findings.issue: Docstrings for `IsCompletelyMonotoneOnIoi.isBernsteinFunction_const_add_halfLinePrimitive` (l.142-143) and `IsCompletelyMonotoneOnIoi.isBernsteinFunction_integral` (l.150) say "of a completely monotone function" and are byte-identical to the docstrings of the `IsCompletelyMonotone` versions at l.166-167 and l.173. In this codebase `IsCompletelyMonotone` is a distinct, stronger predicate (C^∞ on `[0, ∞)`, Basic.lean:73); these theorems assume only `IsCompletelyMonotoneOnIoi` plus `ContinuousOn f (Ici 0)`. The sibling at l.124-125 states the hypotheses correctly.

findings.evidence: Integral.lean:29-39 lists no `IsCompletelyMonotone.` name; Integral.lean:159-178 defines three public theorems in that namespace.
findings.fix: Add a bullet for the `TauCeti.IsCompletelyMonotone.*` triple and for `nonneg_of_continuousOn`.
findings.issue: The `## Main declarations` list names only `IsCompletelyMonotoneOnIoi.*` results and omits the three public `IsCompletelyMonotone.*` theorems (l.162, 168, 174) — the headline "primitive of a completely monotone function" API — as well as `IsCompletelyMonotoneOnIoi.nonneg_of_continuousOn` (l.115).

findings.evidence: grep for `c + ` in Integral.lean matches only l.146 and l.169, both `halfLinePrimitive`.
findings.fix: Either add the `c + ∫ x in 0..t, f x` lemma, or reword the header to say the shift is proved for `halfLinePrimitive`.
findings.issue: Module docstring asserts "and so is `t ↦ c + ∫ x in 0..t, f x` for every `c ≥ 0`", but no declaration in the file states the constant shift in `∫₀ᵗ f` form; `isBernsteinFunction_const_add_halfLinePrimitive` (l.144) is stated only for `halfLinePrimitive`, and `isBernsteinFunction_integral` (l.151) has no shifted variant.

summary: Module docstring and per-declaration docstrings are mostly accurate, but the two `IsCompletelyMonotoneOnIoi` results carry docstrings copied verbatim from their `IsCompletelyMonotone` counterparts and so misstate their hypotheses, and the Main declarations list omits the entire `IsCompletelyMonotone` namespace.
